# observability

OpenTelemetry traces and metrics through Micrometer (OTLP), no Java agent

```bash
axiz add observability
```

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Starter | `pe.axiz:axiz-observability-spring-boot-starter` |
| Stacks del catálogo | servlet, reactive |
| Incluida por defecto en | business, core, gateway, ux, support, event-processor, batch |

## Propiedades que agrega

Valores por defecto seguros en `application.yaml`; los valores de cada ambiente van en el ConfigMap del servicio y los secretos en el secret store.

```yaml
management.opentelemetry.tracing.export.otlp.endpoint: ${OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT:http://localhost:4318/v1/traces}
management.otlp.metrics.export.url: ${OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_ENDPOINT:http://localhost:4318/v1/metrics}
management.tracing.sampling.probability: ${AXIZ_TRACE_SAMPLING:0.1}
```

## Uso

```java
@Metered(event = "order.price")
Money price(Order order) { ... }
```
